contracts.meaning: Complete effect material for effect-claiming commands; full historical Chain_Effect; Decide exactly Reference.
Chain_Effect unconditionally requires complete Matches. Reference requires it for effect observation, historical settle/replay, effect resolution and effect-state execution.
Complete executable reference models and Matches conjunction; full raw capture, result and payload correspondence, not root-only.
Capture source rejects invalid/absent archive; Capture_Matches delegates to complete reference; Matches full conjunction.
Value semantics confer no custody. Independent producer authenticity remains mandatory; Decide equals full Reference.
Historical effect settlement/replay routes to existing Operation_Authority.Decide.
Original historical owner selection followed by current complete Chain_Effect before effect completion.
Capture return exactly Native_Execution_Views.Operation_Decide on captured borrowed inputs.
Native operation transport decision exactly Operation_Expected; implementation references same authority model.
Separate authentic original histories/resource custody requirement; Decide exactly complete Reference.

scope_limits: Tracked Ada .ads/.adb files only; filenames containing cosmogony excluded without semantic inspection. Python production routes enumerated explicitly.
Caller resolution is textual package-alias/source inspection, not compiler-generated whole-program reachability. Source include hierarchy and per-line aliases are retained in inspected files.
Earlier broad rg over the worktree returned exit 2 on generated fixture permission-denied directories. It is not used as complete caller coverage. The subsequent inventory uses git ls-files only.
No runtime failing positive assertion site was captured here. Generic historical Check helper failures do not establish which source assertion was reached first.
No new full proof, compile or runtime result; no product patch selected.
